article.title: Risk factor for developing iliopsoas tendinopathy after total hip arthroplasty : a systematic review and meta-analysis.
article.authors: Romero Padron MA, Darling AJ, Rodriguez AR
article.abstract: Iliopsoas tendinopathy (IPT) is an under-recognized cause of persistent groin pain following total hip arthroplasty (THA), yet reported risk factors remain incompletely synthesized. The purpose of this study was to systematically identify and synthesize risk factors associated with the development of IPT after THA.
